name: LLM Pulse API
description: REST API for the LLM Pulse AI visibility platform. Track brand mentions, citations, sentiment, and Share of Voice across AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, and optional add-on models). Includes the MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint for AI clients. MCP is available on every plan and during eligible trials via OAuth 2.1, with Bearer-token API keys also accepted for headless integrations on the Scale plan or above. Full machine-readable reference at https://llmpulse.ai/api-docs/llms-full.txt. An API key can be limited to one or several projects when it is created, and the set never changes. Such a key sees only those projects: any other project id, domain or name answers ERR_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND exactly like a project that does not exist, listings return only those projects' rows, and operations on the whole account (creating a project, the project draft wizard) answer ERR_KEY_PROJECT_SCOPED. Operations carry vendor extensions: x-plan is the plan or entitlement the endpoint requires beyond an API key (growth, scale or reputation_access), x-write marks endpoints that need a read and write key, x-mcp-tool names the MCP tool that returns the same data, x-mcp-plan gives that tool's plan where it differs, and x-rest-only explains an endpoint with no MCP tool.
